evidence.note: MONICA monitors and calibrates chain-of-thought sycophancy in large reasoning models in real time, at the level of individual reasoning steps during generation (without waiting for a complete answer), using a monitor that tracks sycophantic drift scores and a calibrator that suppresses the behavior once a threshold is exceeded, effectively reducing sycophancy in both intermediate reasoning and final answers across 12 datasets and 3 models.
evidence.title: Real-Time Monitoring and Calibration of Chain-of-Thought Sycophancy in Large Reasoning Models
